title: M4 — Add useful tools and portable skills
description: Give the supervisor a small inspectable capability set: read project plans, retrieve scoped context, run approved lookups and manage workers. Add portable skill instructions with explicit provenance and lazy loading. Reuse worker-native tools. Broader connector catalogs are later work driven by an actual task.
why: Tools perform actions and skills supply reusable procedures without inflating every prompt.

acceptance.text: A planning lookup and a relevant skill improve a real delegated task

outcome.summary: M4 children complete; plantool, lookup, and skills tools ship with tests.
